main_issue: Who will complete Agent D's half-done analysis section for the Thursday pitch while D is away for the family bereavement

A-B.evidence: A pushes everyone to find a way (T10); B says they can't (T11); A then says they'll cover D's section and needs B's section finished, and B agrees 'Okay' (T12-13).

A-C.evidence: C says 'I can't do the analysis part' (T7); A takes on D's section and requires C's finished, C says 'Okay' (T12, T16).

A-D.evidence: A first presses on the deadline (T3), then agrees to cover D's analysis; D thanks A and offers phone support (T18); A replies 'You just take care of your family' (T19).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take on the analysis (T7, T9, T11) and both accept A's arrangement (T13, T16); they do not address each other directly.

B-D.evidence: B says they can't take more work (T9, T11); D accepts A's cover plan, which B also accepts; they never address each other.

C-D.evidence: C asks D where they left off (T5), D answers 'about half done' (T6); C declines the work (T7), and both end up accepting A's cover plan.
